title: scAnyOmics: Foundation-Model Distillation for Any-to-Any Completion of Multi-omics Virtual Cells
abstract: arXiv:2610.41399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in single-cell technologies have enabled the profiling of multiple molecular modalities, including transcriptomics, proteomics, and chromatin accessibility, providing a more comprehensive understanding of cellular states. However, integrating heterogeneous modalities and predicting missing molecular information remain challenging, particularly when paired measurements are limited. Here, we introduce scAnyOmics, a generative framework that distills knowledge from a frozen single-cell foundation model into a multimodal student model. scAnyOmics integrates scRNA-seq, protein-marker measurements, and scATAC-seq into a shared representation, enabling cross-modal prediction and reconstruction of missing modalities. We assembled 690,880 cells from six publicly available studies, covering both paired and partially paired multi-omics measurements, to systematically evaluate its predictive performance. We further evaluated scAnyOmi

translated_title: scAnyOmics：用于多组学虚拟细胞任意对任意补全的基础模型蒸馏
translated_abstract: 近年来单细胞技术的进展使得对多种分子模态（包括转录组学、蛋白质组学和染色质可及性）的分析成为可能，从而能够更全面地理解细胞状态。然而，整合异构模态并预测缺失的分子信息仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在配对测量有限的情况下。在此，我们提出了scAnyOmics，这是一个生成式框架，它将冻结的单细胞基础模型中的知识蒸馏到多模态学生模型中。scAnyOmics将scRNA-seq、蛋白质标记物测量和scATAC-seq整合到一个共享表示中，实现跨模态预测和缺失模态的重构。我们从六项公开研究中收集了690,880个细胞，涵盖配对和部分配对的多组学测量，以系统地评估其预测性能。我们进一步评估了scAnyOmics（摘要在此截断）
tldr: scAnyOmics提出了一种将冻结的单细胞基础模型知识蒸馏到多模态学生模型的生成式框架，可将scRNA-seq、蛋白质测量和scATAC-seq整合到共享表示中，实现任意模态间的跨模态预测与缺失多组学数据的补全。
en_tdlr: scAnyOmics is a generative framework that distills knowledge from a frozen single-cell foundation model into a multimodal student model, integrating scRNA-seq, protein measurements, and scATAC-seq into a shared representation to enable any-to-any cross-modal prediction and completion of missing multi-omics modalities.
